summary: Alibaba Group Holding Limited filed a Form 6-K with the SEC on May 13, 2026, attaching an announcement to the Hong Kong Stock Exchange regarding a final cash dividend of USD 0.13125 per share for the fiscal year ended March 31, 2026. The dividend is an ordinary, final distribution, not requiring shareholder approval. It will be paid on July 6, 2026 to holders of record on June 11, 2026, with an ex-dividend date of June 10, 2026. This is a routine dividend declaration and does not constitute an event-driven special situation; it is a standard periodic cash return to shareholders.
